title: Choose the Polaroid wall ground
question: Workshop Polaroid Wall is the world. Which surface do the prints sit on?

options.label: Cork workshop wall
options.lineage: yard cork with taped instant film
options.thesis: The prints live on a workshop cork wall — the original Polaroid library.
options.viewport: Cork filling the viewport; Polaroids taped on; Find model as a paper tab.
options.risk: Reads as a generic mood-board if the cork is more present than the hulls.

options.label: Open water
options.thesis: The same Polaroid wall, pinned to moving waves so the fleet sits on the water it belongs to.
options.viewport: Full-bleed waves behind the same Polaroid set and Find model tab.
options.risk: The water can fight the photos if the wake is busier than the hulls.

options.label: Wet pontoon
options.thesis: The prints are taped to wet teak pontoon boards — the ground you walk to meet a boat.
options.viewport: Horizontal wet planks behind the same Polaroid set and Find model tab.
options.risk: Reads as a tabletop collage if the wood is too furniture-like.

options.label: Stepped hull
options.thesis: The wall is the HydroStep hull itself: Polaroids taped onto wet stepped gelcoat.
options.viewport: A hard hull step running behind the same Polaroid set and Find model tab.
options.risk: The metal/gelcoat can feel like a product-shot backdrop instead of a library.
